lines.trans: The night air is cool.
Paris is magnificent at this hour.
Where are you going to go tonight?
I am going home quietly.
And me, I am joining my family.
Take good care of your daughter.
Flora grows up so fast already.
You will be an admirable mother.
And you, an excellent screenwriter!
We call each other tomorrow morning?
Promised, we will have a coffee.
Take care of yourself, Andrea.
Thank you for everything, my dear friend.
Goodbye, and see you soon.

examples.text: Votre travail ici est vraiment admirable, Ulrika.
examples.trans: Your work here is truly admirable, Ulrika.

examples.text: Un dévouement admirable pour la cause.
examples.trans: An admirable dedication to the cause.

meanings.note: avoir l'air + adjective = to look, to seem

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?

meanings.en: au contraire = on the contrary; au revoir = goodbye

meanings.note: as a masculine noun: pour le bien de = for the good of

examples.text: C'est du sucre pour le café.

meanings.note: before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

examples.text: J'ai perdu un ami très cher.
examples.trans: I've lost a very dear friend.

meanings.note: before the noun: un ami très cher
after the noun or after être

examples.trans: We went back to my place.

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

meanings.en: from, starting from, as soon as

examples.trans: Call me back as soon as possible.

examples.text: Elle avait déjà pris sa décision.
examples.trans: She had already made her decision.

meanings.note: tu es déjà venu? = have you been here before?
also alone as an exclamation: Excellent!

examples.text: C'est pour faire plaisir à ma famille.
examples.trans: It's to make my family happy.
I want to see my daughter.

meanings.note: une petite fille = a little girl
une note de frais = an expense claim
quelle heure est-il? = what time is it?
à tout à l'heure = see you later
before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà
du matin = a.m., in the morning
merci beaucoup = thank you very much
everyday speech, with a he/she verb form

examples.text: Je suis là pour voir Mathias.

meanings.note: used as an interjection or adjective

examples.trans: We went back to my place.

rentrer.gloss: to go home, to come back

meanings.en: to go home, to get back
to go in, to come in

examples.trans: She wants to find work again.

examples.text: Je retrouve mes amis ce soir.
examples.trans: I'm meeting up with my friends tonight.

retrouver.gloss: to find again; to meet up with

meanings.en: to find again, to get back
meanings.note: retrouver du travail = to find work again

examples.trans: I want to see this film again.

meanings.en: se revoir: to see each other again
meanings.note: on se reverra: we'll meet again

examples.text: Elle est chef scénariste sur la série.
examples.trans: She is head screenwriter on the series.

examples.text: Si tu veux le rôle, tu dois changer.
examples.trans: If you want the part, you have to change.

meanings.en: prendre soin de = to take care of

examples.text: Je ne peux pas venir ce soir.

meanings.note: agrees with the thing owned, not the owner
used alone, after a preposition, or for emphasis: et toi?, avec toi, toi aussi

examples.text: Ça ne va pas du tout.

meanings.note: oui à tout = yes to everything
plural tous (pronounced 'tous' with s): merci à tous
before a noun: tout le monde = everyone

examples.text: Nous allons en parler tranquillement ensemble.
examples.trans: We are going to talk about it calmly together.

examples.text: Il marche tranquillement dans la rue.
examples.trans: He walks quietly down the street.

meanings.note: singular and informal: friends, family, children, colleagues of the same age
place: à Paris, à mon cours

meanings.en: au = à + le, aux = à + les
